mapper.sql: select p.*, c.category_name, u.nick_name manager_name, u.user_name manager_code, d.dept_name manager_dept_name, ad.dept_name applicant_dept_name from pm_project p left join pm_project_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.manager_user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_dept ad on ad.dept_id = p.applicant_dept_id
mapper.select:
and p.project_code like concat('%', #{projectCode}, '%') and p.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%') and (p.category_id = #{categoryId} or exists ( select 1 from pm_project_category c where c.category_id = p.category_id and concat(',', c.ancestors, ',') like concat('%,', #{categoryId}, ',%'))) and p.manager_user_id = #{managerId} and p.status = #{status}
order by p.project_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project(project_code, project_name, category_id, manager_user_id, applicant, applicant_dept_id, start_date, end_date, status, progress, project_goal, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{categoryId}, #{managerId}, #{applicant}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{projectGoal}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_project set project_code = #{projectCode}, project_name = #{projectName}, category_id = #{categoryId}, manager_user_id = #{managerId}, applicant_dept_id = #{applicantDeptId}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, project_goal = #{projectGoal}, project_background = #{projectBackground}, project_scope = #{projectScope}, out_of_scope = #{outOfScope}, expected_outcome = #{expectedOutcome}, resource_requirement = #{resourceRequirement}, budget_required = #{budgetRequired}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, budget_description = #{budgetDescription}, major_risk = #{majorRisk}, technical_feasibility = #{technicalFeasibility}, resource_feasibility = #{resourceFeasibility}, feasibility_conclusion = #{feasibilityConclusion}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where project_id = #{projectId}

update pm_project set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, actual_start_date = #{actualStartDate}, actual_end_date = #{actualEndDate}, pause_reason = #{pauseReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_lifecycle_log(project_id, action, from_status, to_status, reason, operator, operate_time) values(#{projectId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{operator}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from pm_project where project_id in #{id}
